description: Playwright test generation rules for the regression suite. Automation Skill reads this when generating layered test code.

architectureAuthority.role: Defines the six-layer architecture, dependency constraints, and generation patterns. This policy governs runtime behaviour; playwright-standard.json governs structural rules.

structure._targetNote: The PER-APP suite resolved in SKILL Step 0 from pipeline-config.json → apps[appKey].suiteDir (e.g. qe-pipeline/output/regression-suite-BREW/). Suites are isolated per app — never a single shared regression-suite/. All 'regression-suite/...' paths below mean this resolved {suiteDir}.

patterns: direct page imports in test files
locators in service files (services are API-only)
invented/hardcoded API endpoint paths in service files (use story/contract paths or {API_ENDPOINT})

required.waitStrategy: Use auto-waiting (locator-based). If explicit wait needed, use waitForSelector or expect with timeout.
required.assertions: Every test MUST have at least one meaningful expect(). No empty tests.
required.isolation: Tests must not depend on execution order. Each test starts from clean state.
required.cleanup: Use afterEach or test.afterAll for teardown if state was modified.

fixtures.note: Tests import test/expect from fixtures only. Fixtures extend Playwright base test and inject flows.

reporter.note: Allure is mandatory for visual report generation. Use --single-file flag when generating to produce a self-contained HTML.
